<UserControl x:Class="ProcessLens.App.NetworkDevicesView"
 xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
 xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
 xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ProcessLens.App">
 <UserControl.Resources>
  <Style x:Key="NetworkAction" TargetType="Button">
   <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="36"/><Setter Property="Padding" Value="12,8"/>
   <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,8,6"/>
   <Setter Property="ContentTemplate"><Setter.Value><DataTemplate>
    <TextBlock Text="{Binding}" TextWrapping="Wrap" TextAlignment="Center"/>
   </DataTemplate></Setter.Value></Setter>
  </Style>
  <Style x:Key="NetworkCell" TargetType="TextBlock">
   <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
   <Setter Property="Margin" Value="6,5"/><Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
  </Style>
 </UserControl.Resources>
 <Border Background="White" BorderBrush="#E2E5E9" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="12" Padding="16">
  <Grid>
   <Grid.RowDefinitions>
    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
    <RowDefinition Height="*" MinHeight="100"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/><RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
   </Grid.RowDefinitions>
   <StackPanel Margin="0,0,0,10">
    <TextBlock Text="Dispositivi sulla rete" FontSize="22" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
    <local:SelectableText Text="Elenco dalla cache di Windows: può essere incompleto. Aggiornamento solo su richiesta." TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="#64748B"/>
   </StackPanel>
   <WrapPanel Grid.Row="1">
    <Button x:Name="RefreshNetworkButton" Content="Aggiorna elenco" Style="{StaticResource NetworkAction}" Click="RefreshNetwork_Click"/>
    <Button x:Name="CopyNetworkButton" Content="Copia elenco" IsEnabled="False" Style="{StaticResource NetworkAction}" Click="CopyNetwork_Click"/>
    <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkUpdatedText" Text="Elenco non aggiornato" TextWrapping="Wrap" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
   </WrapPanel>
   <Border x:Name="NetworkIndicatorBorder" Grid.Row="2" Background="#F1F5F9" BorderBrush="#64748B" BorderThickness="2,0,0,0" Padding="12,8" Margin="0,4,0,10">
    <StackPanel>
     <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkIndicatorText" Text="Controllo non ancora eseguito" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
     <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkSummaryText" Text="Premi Aggiorna elenco." TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
     <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkNoticeText" Text="" TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="#92400E"/>
    </StackPanel>
   </Border>
   <DataGrid x:Name="NetworkDevicesTable" Grid.Row="3" AutoGenerateColumns="False" IsReadOnly="True"
     CanUserAddRows="False" CanUserDeleteRows="False" EnableRowVirtualization="True" EnableColumnVirtualization="True"
     VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling" SelectionMode="Single" SelectionUnit="FullRow"
     local:GridCopySupport.Enabled="True" HeadersVisibility="Column" MinRowHeight="36"
     SelectionChanged="NetworkSelection_Changed" ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
    <DataGrid.Columns>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="Nome scelto" Binding="{Binding Name, Mode=OneWay}" Width="160" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="IP nella cache" Binding="{Binding Addresses, Mode=OneWay}" Width="210" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="MAC" Binding="{Binding Mac, Mode=OneWay}" Width="155" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="Presenza" Binding="{Binding Presence, Mode=OneWay}" Width="195" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="Riconoscimento" Binding="{Binding Recognition, Mode=OneWay}" Width="180" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
     <DataGridTextColumn Header="Scheda" Binding="{Binding InterfaceName, Mode=OneWay}" Width="140" ElementStyle="{StaticResource NetworkCell}"/>
    </DataGrid.Columns>
   </DataGrid>
   <StackPanel Grid.Row="4" Margin="0,12,0,0">
    <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkSelectionText" Text="Seleziona un dispositivo per riconoscerlo." TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
    <WrapPanel>
     <TextBlock Text="Nome scelto:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,8,6"/>
     <TextBox x:Name="NetworkNameBox" MaxLength="80" MinWidth="150" Width="190" Margin="0,0,8,6"
       VerticalContentAlignment="Center" ToolTip="Nome assegnato da te, per esempio Telefono di casa."/>
     <Button x:Name="RecognizeNetworkButton" Content="È un mio dispositivo / Salva nome" IsEnabled="False"
       Style="{StaticResource NetworkAction}" Click="RecognizeNetwork_Click"/>
     <Button x:Name="ForgetNetworkButton" Content="Rimuovi riconoscimento" IsEnabled="False"
       Style="{StaticResource NetworkAction}" Click="ForgetNetwork_Click"/>
    </WrapPanel>
   </StackPanel>
   <Expander Grid.Row="5" Header="Come leggere l’elenco" Margin="0,6,0,0">
    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" MaxHeight="160">
     <StackPanel Margin="0,8,0,0">
      <local:SelectableText Text="Fonte: Windows GetIpNetTable2 · IPv4/ARP e IPv6/ND. L’elenco può essere incompleto e contenere voci vecchie. Una voce non prova che il dispositivo sia collegato adesso."
        TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
      <local:SelectableText Text="Raggruppamento per MAC e scheda: un dispositivo può comparire più volte. Riconosciuto da te è una tua etichetta, non una verifica dell’identità. MAC e impronta della rete possono cambiare o essere imitati."
        TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
      <local:SelectableText Text="Verde: tutte le voci rilevate con MAC sono riconosciute. Giallo: ci sono voci da riconoscere. Grigio: dati incompleti o riconoscimento non disponibile. Questi stati non certificano la sicurezza della rete."
        TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
      <local:SelectableText x:Name="NetworkDetailsText" Text="Nessuna lettura eseguita." TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
     </StackPanel>
    </ScrollViewer>
   </Expander>
  </Grid>
 </Border>
</UserControl>
